name: B10-0401/2026 (S&D) – Deteriorating situation of media freedom and freedom of expression in Hong Kong following the recent arrest of bookseller Leticia Wong and the convictions of Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the deteriorating situation of media freedom and freedom of expression in Hong Kong following the recent arrest of bookseller Leticia Wong and the convictions of Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns Hong Kong's arrest of bookseller Leticia Wong and the convictions of Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung. It says these prosecutions under Hong Kong's national security laws punish people simply for speaking, writing and protesting. The Parliament calls for their release, along with everyone held only for using these rights. It asks Hong Kong and Chinese authorities to bring those laws in line with international human rights commitments, and asks the European Union to raise these cases with China and strengthen its human rights talks.

- The report is an opinion; it changes no law and orders no release.
- It targets Hong Kong and Chinese authorities, and the European Union's diplomacy with China.
- Next, the resolution goes to the Council, Commission, China's government and Hong Kong's leaders.
